chapter_title: 英文書名、題辭與序言 (Title, Dedication & English Preface)
text:
以下為 1917 年《內外科看護學》（*Lāi-gōa-kho Khàn-hō͘-ha̍k*）前言第 viii 頁之極高精度數位化轉錄與多語對照翻譯：

---

### **頁首 (Header)**

**[English Original]**
viii
PREFACE

> **[台文對照]**
> 第 viii 頁（Tē viii ia̍h）
> 序文（Sū-bûn）
> 
> **[華語對照]**
> 第 viii 頁
> 前言

---

### **第一段 (參考書目續篇 / Bibliography Continued)**

**[English Original]**
Oxford, translated by Mrs. Bayard Lyon; A Handbook for Nurses, Watson; Modern Methods in Nursing, Sanders; Practical Points in Nursing, Stoney; Primary Studies for Nurses, Aikens; Clinical Studies for Nurses, Aikens; Index of Practical Nursing, Cook; Nursing, Robb, translated by Drs. Chestnut and Boggs; The Triangular Bandage, Preston; The Roller Bandage, Preston (from this latter book much of the chapter on bandaging has been translated; into the diagrams I have inserted arrows and numerals); Text-Book of Roller Bandage, Hopkins, translated by Fulton; Medical Nursing, Woodwark; Surgical Nursing, Russell Howard; The Care and Feeding of Children, Holt; Heath’s Minor Surgery and Bandaging; A Synopsis of Surgery, Hey Groves; Text-book of Surgery, Rose and Carless; The Principles and Practice of Medicine, Osler; First Aid, Warwick and Tunstall; The Household Physician, M’Gregor-Robertson; Training in First Aid and Nursing, Beggs; British Red Cross Society Nursing Manual, Cantlie; Wellcome’s Medical Diary; Clinical Methods, Hutchison and Rainy.

> **[台文對照]**
> 牛津（Gû-tin / Oxford，Bayard Lyon 夫人譯）；Watson 著《看護手冊》（Khàn-hō͘ Chhiú-chheh）；Sanders 著《當代看護法》（Tng-tāi Khàn-hō͘-hoat）；Stoney 著《實用看護要點》（Si̍t-iōng Khàn-hō͘ Iàu-tiám）；Aikens 著《看護初級研究》（Khàn-hō͘ Chho͘-kip Gián-kiù）；Aikens 著《看護臨床研究》（Khàn-hō͘ Lîm-tshn̂g Gián-kiù）；Cook 著《實用看護索引》（Si̍t-iōng Khàn-hō͘ Sek-ín）；Robb 著《看護學》（Khàn-hō͘-ha̍k，Chestnut 與 Boggs 兩位博士譯）；Preston 著《三角繃帶》（Saⁿ-kak Pang-tài）；Preston 著《捲軸繃帶》（Kńg-te̍k Pang-tài，後面這本書有關包紮的章節大部分攏有翻譯入來；插圖內底我也加入箭頭佮數字標示）；Hopkins 著《捲軸繃帶教科書》（Kńg-te̍k Pang-tài Kàu-kho-su，Fulton 譯）；Woodwark 著《內科看護》（Lāi-kho Khàn-hō͘）；Russell Howard 著《外科看護》（Gōa-kho Khàn-hō͘）；Holt 著《兒童的照顧與餵養》（Jî-tông ê Chiàu-kò͘ kap Ióng-io̍k）；《Heath 氏小外科與繃帶學》（Heath-sī Sió-gōa-kho kap Pang-tài-ha̍k）；Hey Groves 著《外科學大綱》（Gōa-kho-ha̍k Tāi-kong）；Rose kap Carless 合著《外科學教科書》（Gōa-kho-ha̍k Kàu-kho-su）；Osler 著《內科學原理與實務》（Lāi-kho-ha̍k Goân-lí kap Si̍t-bū）；Warwick kap Tunstall 合著《急救學》（Kip-kiù-ha̍k）；M’Gregor-Robertson 著《家庭醫師》（Ka-têng I-si）；Beggs 著《急救與看護訓練》（Kip-kiù kap Khàn-hō͘ Hùn-liān）；Cantlie 著《英國紅十字會看護手冊》（Eng-kok Âng-si̍p-jī-hōe Khàn-hō͘ Chhiú-chheh）；《Wellcome 醫學日記》（Wellcome I-ha̍k Ji̍t-kì）；Hutchison kap Rainy 合著《臨床方法學》（Lîm-tshn̂g Hong-hoat-ha̍k）。
> 
> **[華語對照]**
> 牛津（Oxford，由 Bayard Lyon 夫人翻譯）；Watson 著《護理手冊》；Sanders 著《現代護理方法》；Stoney 著《實用護理要點》；Aikens 著《護士基礎研習》；Aikens 著《護士臨床研習》；Cook 著《實用護理索引》；Robb 著《護理學》（由 Chestnut 與 Boggs 兩位博士翻譯）；Preston 著《三角巾包紮》；Preston 著《捲軸繃帶》（後者書中關於包紮的章節多已譯出；筆者亦在圖解中增補了箭頭與數字符號）；Hopkins 著《捲軸繃帶教科書》（由 Fulton 翻譯）；Woodwark 著《內科護理》；Russell Howard 著《外科護理》；Holt 著《兒童照護與哺育》；《Heath 氏小外科與包紮學》；Hey Groves 著《外科學大綱》；Rose 與 Carless 合著《外科學教科書》；Osler 著《內科學原理與實務》；Warwick 與 Tunstall 合著《急救學》；M’Gregor-Robertson 著《家庭醫師》；Beggs 著《急救與護理訓練》；Cantlie 著《英國紅十字會護理手冊》；《Wellcome 醫學日誌》；Hutchison 與 Rainy 合著《臨床方法學》。

---

### **第二段 (致謝：校訂與台灣友人協作)**

**[English Original]**
The whole work has been revised carefully by Mrs. Gushue-Taylor, whose aid by expert suggestion and criticism has helped much in the elimination of many errors. Much invaluable assistance has been derived from several Formosan friends who are acknowledged in the Formosan preface. I have to thank Mr. Tân Tōa-lô for assistance in the revision of proofs.

> **[台文對照]**
> 全部的文稿攏經過戴仁壽夫人（Mrs. Gushue-Taylor）詳細的校閱，伊憑著專業的建議佮評論，幫贊真大，消除真濟錯誤（chhò-gō͘）。閣有對幾若位台灣朋友得到真寶貴的協助，我已經在台文序言內底向（hiòng）𪜶致謝。我特別著感謝陳大老先生（Mr. Tân Tōa-lô）在校對方面所提供的幫贊。
> 
> *(Chôan-pō͘ ê bûn-kó lóng keng-kòe Tè Jîn-siū Hu-jîn siông-sè ê kàu-oa̍t, i pîn-tio̍h choan-gia̍p ê kiàn-gī kap phêng-lūn, pang-chān chin tōa, siau-tû chin chē chhò-gō͘. Koh-ū tùi kúi-lā-ūi Tâi-oân pêng-iú tek-tio̍h chin pó-kùi ê hia̍p-chō͘, góa í-keng chāi Tâi-bûn sū-giân lāi-té hiòng in tì-siā. Góa te̍k-pia̍t tio̍h kám-siā Tân Tōa-lô Sian-siⁿ chāi kàu-tùi hong-bīn só͘ thê-kiong ê pang-chān.)*
> 
> **[華語對照]**
> 全書承蒙戴仁壽夫人（Mrs. Gushue-Taylor）細心校閱，其基於專業素養所提出的建議與批評，對消除書中諸多謬誤裨益良多。此外，亦獲得多位台灣友人的寶貴協助，筆者已於台文序言中向彼等致謝。筆者特此感謝陳大老先生在校對清樣工作上所給予的協助。

---

### **第三段 (致謝印刷廠與署名)**

**[English Original]**
Finally I have to thank the Fukuin Printing Co., who have reproduced many illustrations and have carried out their share in the work in a most efficient manner.

G. GUSHUE-TAYLOR.

Tainan, Formosa, Japan,
September, 1917.

> **[台文對照]**
> 上尾，我著感謝福音印刷株式會社（Fukuin Printing Co.），𪜶製版複印真濟圖版插畫，並且以極其高效率的方式完成𪜶所負責的工作。
> 
> *(Siōng-bóe, góa tio̍h kám-siā Hok-im Ìn-soat Tu-sek Hōe-siā, in chè-pán ho̍k-ìn chin chē tô͘-pán chhap-ōe, pēng-chhiáⁿ í ke̍k-kî ko-hāu-lu̍t ê hong-sek oân-sêng in só͘ hū-chek ê kang-chok.)*
> 
> 戴仁壽（G. GUSHUE-TAYLOR）
> 
> 於 日本・台灣・台南（Tâi-lâm, Tâi-oân, Ji̍t-pún）
> 1917 年 9 月

> **[華語對照]**
> 最後，筆者謹向福音印刷株式會社（Fukuin Printing Co.）致謝，該社精確翻印了大量插圖，並以極高之效率圓滿完成了分內之印製工作。
> 
> 戴仁壽（G. GUSHUE-TAYLOR）
> 
> 於 日本統治下之台灣台南
> 1917 年 9 月
